preferences.title: Container position
preferences.hint: Personal setting for the current user, shared across their characters and devices.

errors.permission: You need ownership of both actors. Installed items must be uninstalled first.
errors.cycle: A container cannot contain itself or one of its parents.
errors.busy: An inventory transfer is already in progress. Please wait.
errors.brokenInstallation: An installed item is missing. Repair its installation before transferring.
errors.sharedInstallation: An item is also installed outside this container. Uninstall it there before transferring.
errors.changed: The source inventory changed during transfer. The transfer was cancelled.
errors.incomplete: The transfer was incomplete and has been rolled back.
errors.recovery: Recovery was incomplete. Items have been preserved; ask the GM to check both inventories before retrying.
errors.failed: Container operation failed. Check both inventories and the console before retrying.
